correctness.rationale: The field arithmetic convention was independently reconstructed. The ten displayed vectors have binary rank ten. For every one of the 126 scalars outside the base field, the combined binary rank of U and its scalar multiple is exactly twenty, so their intersection is zero. This excludes two independent U-vectors on one ambient field line. The standard Desarguesian-spread bound is floor(21/2)=10, hence the construction is maximum scattered. Independent exact recomputation reproduced the rank-ten basis and all 126 rank-twenty tests; the coding consequence then follows from the cited extremal-code/scattered-subspace characterization.
